sources.label: MobilityData — Mumbai BEST/KDMT bus GTFS archive
sources.notes: Backs bus_stops.geojson (7195) and bus_routes.geojson (581). MobilityData source record points to a public mumbai-gtfs compatibility archive for BEST/KDMT bus schedules.

sources.label: MobilityData — Indian Railways GTFS city extract for Mumbai local/EMU services
sources.notes: Unofficial MobilityData Indian Railways GTFS archive. Backs suburban_rail_gtfs_stations.geojson (98) and suburban_rail_gtfs_routes.geojson (207) using Mumbai-region bbox plus LOCAL/EMU/MEMU filters. It is a schedule lead, not an official Western/Central Railway suburban GTFS disclosure.

sources.label: BBBike Bombay OSM extract — suburban rail geometry
sources.notes: Backs suburban_rail.geojson (2545 line segments) and suburban_rail_stations.geojson (88 stations). This is OSM-derived geometry and remains non-authoritative.

sources.label: Mumbai Metro unofficial constructed static GTFS
sources.notes: Backs metro_gtfs_stops.geojson (79) and metro_gtfs_routes.geojson (6). Constructed from MMRDA/MMMOCL/MMRC public station/source material plus local OSM route/station geometry; not an agency-published GTFS feed. Includes operational/partly operational Lines 1, 2A, 2B Phase 1, 3, 7, and 9 Phase 1; planned lines such as Line 14 are excluded until operational status is verified.
